detail.title: Experimental and Theoretical Foundations of Prebiotic Heredity
detail.summary: This notebook synthesizes initial findings regarding the shift from non-templated chemical persistence to heritable evolutionary units. While theoretical models provide robust frameworks for autocatalytic heredity, current experimental efforts—such as serial dilution protocols using basic food sets—are essential to determine if these networks meet the necessary stability thresholds to sustain Darwinian-like dynamics.
detail.reason: Notebook required to consolidate initial theoretical and experimental evidence for the heredity-thresholds-study project.
